approved:
The Ridgeline Trail is a mid-weight trail shoe for long days on mixed ground: a grippy outsole, a recycled mesh upper and a toe cap that takes the knocks.

  • Vibram outsole with 4 mm lugs
  • Recycled mesh upper, 310 g per shoe
  • Wide fit in every size
